persona.name: Élise Moreau

occupation.title: UX Designer
occupation.description: Élise works as a UX Designer at a mid-sized digital agency in Lyon, creating user-centered website and mobile app designs for a variety of clients. Her role involves collaborating with developers, project managers, and clients to translate user needs into clear, intuitive interfaces.

persona.education: She earned a Master’s degree in Interaction Design from L'École de Design Nantes Atlantique after completing a bachelor's in Communication.

openness.description: Élise enjoys exploring new design trends and is open to creative ideas.

conscientiousness.description: She stays organized and reliably meets project deadlines.

extraversion.description: She contributes comfortably in group discussions but doesn’t seek the spotlight.

agreeableness.description: She values cooperation and is considerate of others’ viewpoints.

neuroticism.description: She handles stress calmly, though occasionally worries about new projects.

collectivism.description: She prefers working in collaborative teams and values group harmony.

hierarchy_preference.description: She shows basic respect for structure but appreciates some informality.

shame_sensitivity.description: She dislikes drawing negative attention but recovers quickly from feedback.

conflict_tolerance.description: She addresses disagreements diplomatically without escalation.

uncertainty_avoidance.description: She favors clear guidelines but adapts if the situation changes.

traits: enjoys making work enjoyable for the team
